description: Publishes a community entry in the published app, owned by the developer's own user there (created on first use), skipping the review queue: users see it at once. The community's rules apply: module on, allowed contentType and category, payload within maxPayloadBytes. Undo: neblla_delete_community_entry.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

contentType.description: One of the app's content types (any when it has none).

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

fields.description: Values of the community's own fields (neblla_get_community_config).

i18n.description: Title and summary in other languages: { fr: { title, summary } }, up to 16.

lang.description: The language of title and summary, e.g. "es".

parentId.description: The entry this one derives from (a reply, a version).

payload.description: The JSON stored for this entry.

name: neblla_publish_community_entry
title: Publish a community entry
